mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) environment compresses equity discount rates and reduces the cost of capital, generating positive 20-day S&P 500 returns as investors anticipate stable economic growth and higher risk appetite.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% over 3 months signals labor market strength, reducing recession risk and driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns through improved consumer spending and corporate earnings outlook.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in periods where UNRATE has fallen below 3.5% in the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC is negative over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Joint expansion in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust aggregate demand, reducing economic uncertainty and generating positive 20-day S&P 500 returns through sustained corporate profit growth.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and HOUST both increase in the prior month
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not positive in more than 50% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 3.0%) increases the cost of capital and reduces liquidity, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns as investors reassess equity valuations and risk exposure.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) in periods when FEDFUNDS has risen above 3.0% in the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC is positive over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals expanding economic activity, reducing recession probability and driving positive 60-day S&P 500 returns through sustained corporate earnings growth and investor confidence.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in periods when quarterly GDP growth exceeds 2.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index 2017=100) indicates manufacturing contraction, increasing recession risk and generating negative 5-day S&P 500 returns through reduced corporate revenue expectations.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 100 in the prior month
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) in periods when INDPRO has fallen below 100, or the Rank IC is positive over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and stable federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 2.5%) signals healthy labor market conditions without aggressive monetary tightening, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns through sustained consumer spending.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases and FEDFUNDS remains below 2.5% in the prior month
regime_hint: labor market strength without rate hikes
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not positive in more than 50% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle economic expansion (UNRATE < 4.0% for two consecutive months) increases the probability of Fed rate hikes and earnings deceleration, leading to negative 60-day S&P 500 returns as investors anticipate cycle exhaustion.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) in periods when UNRATE has been below 4.0% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC is positive over any 3-year rolling window.
